Der futuristische Komplex von Santiago C: The futuristic complex by Santiago Calatrava and Félix Candela in the old Turia riverbed. The Hemisfèric opened first in 1998; the Oceanogràfic is the largest aquarium in Europe.
Der achteckige Glockenturm der Kathedral: The cathedral's octagonal Gothic bell tower, 14th/15th century, about 51 metres high. 207 steps lead up to the platform with a view over the whole city.
Die spätgotische Seidenbörse (1482–1548): The late-Gothic silk exchange (1482–1548) with its pillared hall has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1996 – testimony to Valencia's trading power in the 15th century.
Stadttor von 1392–1398, eines der bester: City gate from 1392–1398, one of the best-preserved Gothic city gates in Europe. At the end of February the Fallas season opens here with the "Crida".
Die modernistische Markthalle wurde 1928: The modernist market hall opened in 1928 and is one of the largest in Europe. Under the dome: fish, jamón, vegetables, saffron – and the horchata bar.
Nach der Flutkatastrophe von 1957 wurde: After the flood disaster of 1957 the river Turia was diverted. A nine-kilometre park was created in the old riverbed, opened in 1986 – every cyclist's favourite territory.
Der breite Stadtstrand mit Promenade. De: The wide city beach with its promenade. The painter Joaquín Sorolla captured the light of Valencia on canvas here.
Der Hafen wurde für den America’s Cup 20: The harbour was rebuilt for the 2007 America's Cup. Today: sailing boats, Veles e Vents and concerts by the water.
Der Turia-Brunnen zeigt den Flussgott mi: The Turia fountain shows the river god with eight women – the eight irrigation channels of the Huerta. Every Thursday at noon the Water Tribunal, the oldest court in Europe (UNESCO 2009), sits here.
Während der Fallas (1.–19. März) knallt: During the Fallas (1–19 March) the Mascletà goes off here every day at 2 pm: minutes of firecrackers until the ground shakes.
Eines der bedeutendsten Kunstmuseen Span: One of the most important art museums in Spain: Sorolla, Goya, El Greco and a self-portrait by Velázquez hang here.
Modernistischer Bahnhof von 1917, verzie: Modernist railway station from 1917, decorated with oranges, azulejos and mosaics – Valencia's most beautiful calling card.
Die riesigen Figuren aus Holz und Pappma: The giant figures of wood and papier-mâché are built over months – and burned on the night of 19 March at the Cremà. Only one ninot is pardoned each year.
